Frequently asked questions

How many remote jobs are open in the United States?

Fortune Jobs AI lists 930 open remote jobs in the United States as of November 24, 2026.

How much do remote jobs in the United States pay?

The 25th–75th percentile of listed salary midpoints is $88,256–$150,800 a year, based on 128 listings where employers list pay. Listings without usable pay data are excluded; hourly and yearly pay are not mixed.

Which employers are hiring for remote jobs in the United States?

Employers in this catalogue include GovCIO (88 listings), Cognizant (51 listings), Serco (38 listings), Capital One (35 listings), and SitusAMC (31 listings).

Are there entry-level remote jobs in the United States?

48 listings mention entry-level, new-grad, junior or graduate roles in the title or description. Review the original posting for its experience requirements.

Is every listing fully remote from any state?

Check each listing; some remote jobs are limited to certain states or include location and worksite requirements. A remote label does not mean work from anywhere.
